Passionate about solving meaningful problems with technology and building world-class teams, he leads the creation of Nominal’s next-generation Financial Operating System. His work pioneers the use of Generative AI in accounting and financial operations. Previously, he served as an Engineering Lead at Cognigo, acquired by NetApp.
